runner_identity.runner_sha256_is_the_durable_citation: the digest identifies the code that produced this receipt whatever happens to the history above it. Resolve it first.
runner_identity.why_that_field: false means the module had uncommitted edits when it ran, so the commit ids below it describe a DIFFERENT file than the one that produced these numbers. Stated, never inferred.

import_closure.digested: from the bytes each module held when it FIRST entered this run -- never re-read

wrapper.note: false means this step was NOT inside the capped scope. That is correct only for a step under 60 s and 1 GiB that opens no tape; anything else takes the lock FIRST and REFUSES if it is held.
wrapper.why_the_SLICE_and_not_the_scope: the first version of this field tested `scope.startswith('run-')` and reported TRUE for an UNWRAPPED run, because the calling shell is itself inside a transient scope (app.slice). A field that is true either way is a control that cannot fail. `--slice=research.slice` is what the rule-20 wrapper adds and nothing else in this session does.
